notes.title: Season 3 & Battle of the Dancers is out now for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale!
notes.content:
[h1]Season 3 of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale is OUT NOW![/h1]

Hey Flock! 👋 Season 3 is now out for Headbangers, which sees the arrival of our brand new gamemode: Battle of the Dancers. Ready for 1v1 rhythm battles to a selection of new tracks? Discover more by watching our Season 3 Launch Trailer below 👇

[previewyoutube=hmEkd7G0woA;full][/previewyoutube][h3]🪩 Battle of the Dancers: How to Play[/h3]
In Battle of the Dancers, the last Pigeon standing wins... or you could say it is Owl or nothing! Your aim to play the music in rhythm, without any mistakes. Hit all buttons in a row without any mistakes and you’ll begin filling up your fireball gauge. When this fills, you’ll send a devastating fireball at your opponent, which lowers their health bar. The pigeon with the most health at the end of the round is the winner and can deal the final blow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/305bb5d21b3cce0a908ac5d54af21bbe39495c01.gif[/img]
[h3]📈 Voting Options, Ranked Mode & More![/h3]
When creating our new game mode, we have implemented changes based on community feedback since our launch in October 2023. Battle of the Dancers will include features such as [b]voting options, expanding on the music genres and the addition of a Ranked Mode- all for Battle of the Dancers![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/854fbcb2c559f2f9293fd3a7f2c07c34b15b91f6.gif[/img]
[h3]🎨 New Challenge Skin: The Painter Pigeon[/h3]
We are happy to introduce our new Challenge Skin for Season 3... The Painter Pigeon. Unlock this skin by completing in-game challenges and become an art icon just like the famous painters Pigecasso and Michelangelcrow!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/c8df3777ac26f906c228badd392a8109378b46f1.gif[/img]
[h3]3️⃣ Season 3's Other Features[/h3]
Alongside the release of Battle of the Dancers and a new Challenge Skin for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale, Season 3 brings a refresh to the in-game shop, a fresh 30-tiered free battle pass with new cosmetic items and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/7159c746ec7583478792126ca5a46a12f51c8d31.gif[/img]
[h3]Steam Cloud Saves[/h3]
For our Season 3 update, we have pushed out a small change to activate the Steam Cloud Saves feature. Unfortunately, we have no control over which save file will be uploaded to the Steam Cloud. We'd recommend to players who've played Headbangers: Rhythm Royale on multiple devices to play first on your device with the local save that you'd want to keep from 4 April 2024 14:00 BST onwards. This is to ensure the correct save file is uploaded to Steam Cloud.

We're excited to implement Steam Cloud Save and for progress to translate between players' multiple devices. For Multi-PC and Steam Deck users, we hope this feature helps you hit all the levels on your new Season 3 Battle Pass!

[h3]Support[/h3]
If players have any issues with Steam Cloud Saves or run into any bugs, please reach out to our Support Team via the following link: https://www.team17.com/support/


[h3]Feeling Peckish Pack: Out Now[/h3]
In case you missed it, we recently released our third paid cosmetics pack for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale in the Feeling Peckish Pack! This paid DLC includes 4 Full Costumes, 4 Garments, 1 Taunt, 5 Taunt Voices, 1 Neck Sound.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333290/Headbangers__Feeling_Peckish/

[h3]If you enjoy this update, please consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761620/Headbangers_Rhythm_Royale/]leaving a review of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale[/url] on Steam! 🐥[/h3]

We hope you enjoy Season 3 of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale! 👋

[list][*] Open the Steam Menu by pressing the button labelled 'Steam' on your Steam Deck
[*] Select 'Settings' from the list and then select 'System'.

notes.title: Season 2 of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Season 2 of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale is Out Now for Steam![/h1]
Hey Flock! Today we are extremely excited to welcome you to a brand new season of Headbangers Rhythm Royale. But what's new for the Pigeons in our free Season 2 update? 🐥

[h2]NEW COSMETICS[/h2]
The new season of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale brings all new cosmetics including the Mad Scientist Pigeon, the Cow Pigeon, the Courgette Pigeon and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/214fbeb4b169f0de99a9caecff34b3f3b5dec17c.gif[/img]

Along with our new Full Outfits, we also have tonnes of new individual customisation items! Ready to design the Pigeon of your dreams? Mix and match your favourite items to create a unique look. 🤩

Season 2 is the perfect time to change up your customisation items... a Pigeon makeover if you will!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/5763c0b91d081e500c15eef41d83da3dc7a4eb33.gif[/img]
[h2]FRESH AND FREE BATTLE PASS[/h2]
In Season 2, you will find a fresh Battle Pass containing 30 new levels! The[b] Battle Pass in Headbangers: Rhythm Royale is completely free[/b], so all players can jump in today and start gaining XP for your Battle Pass levels! The Season 2 Battle Pass contains all new cosmetics items including new Full Outfits, Individual Items, Taunts, Voices and more!

We've been listening to all players feedback around the Season 1 Battle Pass and it's functionality. From this, we have decided to make some tweaks based off your suggestions! For Season 2, we've increased the amount of XP needed for each individual level. We hope this is a greater challenge for all and that it makes our Battle Pass feel even more rewarding!

Remember Flock, you gain more XP by progressing further in each game of Headbangers so do whatever it takes to stay in each round of rhythm chaos! We hope you are ready to test your Headbangers skills to see if you can unlock our Level 30 Full Costume: [b]The Cinema Pigeon![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/346bb258f31e8d4d1cbfbb81b135173b449a7ff2.png[/img][h2]A NEW CHALLENGE SKIN[/h2]
Are you ready to challenge for the title? Alongside testing your skills in our new Battle Pass, we have an even bigger test waiting for you! In Season 2, we have a brand new Challenge Skin in [b]The Boxer Pigeon![/b] Unlock this skin in Headbangers: Rhythm Royale by completing twelve new in-game challenges.

[b]Didn't unlock all of the Challenge Skins in Season 1? Don't worry, we've got you! [/b]All previous Challenge Skins from Season 1 are featured in Season 2, with all your Challenge progression carrying over from the previous Season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/902dae4f2bba6f8937537ef67298d0f6dfd9cdf2.png[/img][h2]CRUMBS[/h2]
We've seen questions from the community regarding Crumbs in Season 2. We want to clarify that your Season 1 Crumbs progression will carry over to Season 2! We've opted to not reset Crumbs progress for multiple reasons. Firstly, players can begin purchasing the new cosmetic items from the very start of the Season. Secondly, we've seen you all working hard to earn more Crumbs even after you've completed the Shop and bought all the cosmetic items in Season 1. This dedication to Headbangers is amazing and deserves to be celebrated. We are genuinely grateful for the amount of hours you've played our Rhythm Battle Royale game for!

If you have any feedback around this change or any other Season 2 tweaks, please get in touch with us in our Headbangers Discord Server! We have a dedicated player feedback channel and frequently update the community regarding changes for Headbangers: https://discord.gg/n35cwGy6nP

notes.title: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale I Hotfix 3
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Flock! 👋🐤 [/h3]

The third hotfix is now live for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale for all platforms! Hotfix 3 reduces the lobby timer to 60 seconds and contains fixes to the lobby backfill bugs, fixes to specific challenges and more.

Before we soar into more information around the hotfix, we would like to inform the community that [b]the team are working on an issue surrounding a network error, preventing some players from launching the game.[/b] Once we have a fix, we will update the community with this news. We hope to have a fix for this soon across all platforms and appreciate the community's patience while we remedy this issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/8d8310be37b8cc70e4502d3d44c07a09a3e536a9.png[/img]
[h2]Hotfix 3 - Lobby Changes:[/h2]
[h3]After listening to players' feedback from our launch week, we have altered the lobby timer and fixed an issue surrounding lobby backfill! 🤟[/h3]

At launch, our lobby timer was set to 120 seconds. Many players stated that this timer was too long, that players were leaving lobbies before the two-minute mark and that we should reduce this timer. With Hotfix 3, we have reduced this timer to 60 seconds. Now, players will spend less time in the lobby menu and more time playing our rhythm minigames! 🎧

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/e507051327c1049967fac8206e39ceaa86e86222.gif[/img]

On our October 31st launch, many community members noticed a bug around players leaving lobbies. When a player left an open lobby, a bug caused the lobby to never refill back to 30 players. In Hotfix 3, we have fixed this issue with server backfill. With Hotfix 3, if players leave during the timer screen, the lobby can still fill back to 30 players. Full lobbies for all! 🥳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/478bb3dcd5da7f531ad4a74e4bb6aec92b67fd76.gif[/img]

⬇️ Full patch notes for Hotfix 3 can be found below:
[h3]PATCH NOTES - HOTFIX 3[/h3]
[list][*] Reduced the lobby waiting time to 60 seconds.
[*] Fixed an issue with the server backfill to ensure remaining free slots in a lobby are filled with players.
[*] Fixed an issue where the challenge outfit for the Aubergine skin would not unlock if a disconnection occurs.
[*] Fixed an issue around Crumb Unlocks. Future crumb level unlocks in the battle pass will be rewarded as the bug around Crumb Unlocks, which would sometimes not be awarded, is now fixed.*
[*] Fixed an issue where the sound effects would be missing when using the Team17 overlay.[/list]
*At this moment, we have fixed this issue for future Crumbs Level unlocks. If you unlocked a crumbs pack before Hotfix 3 and encountered this issue, your Crumb total will not be fixed. We will continue the investigation into this issue and provide further information around this bug in the future.

notes.title: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale - FAQs
notes.content:
We are just hours away from the launch of Headbangers: Rhythm Royale! Are you ready to join the ✨ Big Pigeon Party? ✨

[h3]Headbangers launches at 5PM GMT on 31st October![/h3]

With the launch being so close, we wanted to share our FAQ page here on Steam! If you have any questions around Headbangers: Rhythm Royale, please ask them in our Steam Discussions, our Headbangers Discord server or in the discussions below. 😄

[h3][url=https://discord.gg/n35cwGy6nP]➡️ Join our Headbangers Discord Server![/url][/h3]

[h2]HEADBANGERS RHYTHM ROYALE FAQs[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/352b6d9e9164b8c1434a9ffd45b8111fa0d795a5.png[/img]
[h3]What is Headbangers Rhythm Royale?[/h3]
Have you ever looked at a Pigeon and thought, “what is going on in your head?”
Well, think no more! Headbangers puts you and 29 others into the eye of the Pigeon while you battle it out in rhythmic challenges to find out who is the ultimate Master Headbanger.
Compete against each other in mind- bending musical minigames, screw over your competitors with powerups, and collect Crumbs to customise your very own Pigeon!

[h3]When will Headbangers release?[/h3]
For Steam, Headbangers will release at 5PM GMT on October 31st.

[h3]How much will it cost?[/h3]
The standard version of Headbangers Rhythm Royale is available for £19.99/$19.99/€19.99, with the Deluxe Edition being available for £29.99/$29.99/€29.99.

The Gold Edition is available for £34.99/$34.99/€34.99.

[h3]What do you get in the Deluxe Edition of Headbangers?[/h3]
The Deluxe Edition of Headbangers includes the base game of Headbangers and the Season Pass (Pigeon Pass).

[h3]What do you get in the Gold Edition of Headbangers?[/h3]
The Gold Edition of Headbangers includes the base game of Headbangers, two soundtracks of Headbangers music (Run Pigeon Run I & II and The Crumbs Collection) and the Season Pass (Pigeon Pass).

If you pre-purchased the deluxe edition you will have a free upgrade to the Gold Edition, as those who pre-purchased the deluxe edition will get the soundtrack.

[h3]What is the Season Pass / Pigeon Pass?[/h3]
The ‘Pigeon Pass’ grants players access to three unique DLC packs. The first DLC pack available, ‘Flock & Roll’, features four full costumes, four garments, a taunt and five taunt voices, and one neck sound, with content for the two remaining DLC packs being available before April 2024.

[h3]Does Headbangers feature cross-play between platforms?[/h3]
Cross-platform play is a feature of Headbangers, through our ‘Team17 friends’ features. This allows players to connect with friends and play rounds of Headbangers, no matter their platform of choice! 

[h3]Will there be updates after release?[/h3]
Absolutely! Keep your pigeon eyes peeled on our social media accounts as we will be sharing more information about Season 2 and Season 3 in the upcoming months.

[h3]How many players can play in one lobby in Headbangers?[/h3]
Headbangers has 30 pigeon player lobbies.

[h3]How many minigames does Headbangers have?[/h3]
Headbangers contains 23 minigames that all test different skills, including your rhythm, accuracy, memory, reaction speed and even your ability to rap!

[h3]How many rounds do you play in each game of Headbangers?[/h3]
Battle through four rounds of intense musical minigames each time you play Headbangers! Here’s a list of what minigames are available for each round of Headbangers:

Round 1: Garden Party, Guess it!, Guilty!, Run Pigeon Run I, Yes Commander!, Piano Mezzo Forte
Round 2: Fitness, The Ring, First Piano Shooter, Faster Than Sound, Stereo Ga Ga, Super Striker, 
Round 3: Glottissimo, The Battle Box, The Perfect Shot, The Stunt Moles, The Space Race, To The Sky
Round 4: The Final Ride, After Party, That 70’s Race, Run Pigeon Run 2, Oui Votre Majesté

[h3]I have some feedback for Headbangers! Where should I send this?[/h3]
Please join our Headbangers Discord Server and head to the #feedback channel to leave your feedback! https://discord.gg/n35cwGy6nP 

[h3]What languages will Headbangers support at launch?[/h3]
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and Russian.

[h3]What are the System Requirements for Headbangers?[/h3]
MINIMUM:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. OS: Windows 10. Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD FX-4350. Memory: 8 GB RAM. Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730, 1 GB / AMD Radeon R7 240, 1 GB. DirectX: Version 11. Network: Broadband Internet connection. Storage: 2 GB available space.

RECOMMENDED:
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. OS: Windows 10. Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD FX-8370. Memory: 8 GB RAM. Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GRX 650 Ti, 2 GB / AMD Radeon HD 7770, 2GB / Intel Arc A370M, 4GB. DirectX: Version 11. Network: Broadband Internet connection. Storage: 2 GB available space.

[h3]My controller is showing the incorrect inputs on Steam. How do I fix this?[/h3]
For correct controller inputs on Steam whilst playing Headbangers, please do not use Steam inputs and plug your controller directly into your PC/device.

[h3]Will there be a Physical Release of Headbangers?[/h3]
There are currently no plans for a physical release.

Get in touch with our Customer Support team: https://www.team17.com/support/

[h3]Our shop[/h3]
Alongside this, there’s a shop where you can spend your hard-earned breadcrumbs to unlock certain cosmetics. You unlock crumbs at the end of each Headbangers game, and you gain more crumbs based on how far you progress through our rhythm minigames. There’s no way to purchase crumbs- they’re only obtained by playing rounds of Headbangers!

Before we breakdown all the cosmetics in DLC 1, we’d like to say that our paid DLCs are entirely optional and cosmetic-only! Headbangers DLCs are separate from our battle pass and breadcrumbs in-game currency.

For each DLC Pack, you will unlock 4 full costumes, 4 garments, 1 taunt, 5 taunt voices and 1 neck sound. DLC 1 will cost 3.79. Here’s a look at all the cosmetics in DLC 1:

[h3]Headbangers Closed Tech Test FAQ[/h3]

[u]When can I sign up for the closed tech test?[/u]
Head to the Headbangers Steam store page below and click ‘Request Access’ on Join the Headbangers Closed Tech Test Playtest. You will then receive an email when the playtest is open.

[u]When will the closed tech test sign ups close?[/u]
Sign ups will close at 12am BST on 11th September.

[u]When will I hear if I got a space in the closed tech test?[/u]
Players will receive an email from the email address linked to their steam account, if they are accepted into the closed tech test.

[u]When will the closed tech test take place?[/u]
The closed tech test for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale will run from 4th September at 1pm BST until 11th September at 12am BST.

[u]How many minigames will be available to play in the closed tech test?[/u]
11 minigames will be available to play in the closed tech test, which includes:

Round 1: Garden Party, Guess it, Yes Commander
Round 2: First Piano Shooter, Fitness, Faster Than Sound
Round 3: To The Sky, The Battle Box, The Stunt Moles
Round 4: That 70s Race, Run Pigeon Run 2

[u]How many battle pass levels will be available in the closed tech test?[/u]
In the closed tech test, 20 levels of our free battle pass will be available to unlock. However, at launch the battle pass will contain 40 levels for players to progress through.

[u]How can you leave feedback around the closed tech test?[/u]
Please leave any and all feedback around the closed tech test for Headbangers in our official Discord server: https://bit.ly/HeadbangersDiscord

[u]Will there be other chances to play Headbangers: Rhythm Royale before launch on October 31st?[/u]
Currently this is the only planned tech test for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale. However, server tests are very important to us. In the future, we may look to do this closed tech test for other consoles. For any updates around this, please follow our social media channels below!

notes.title: Coo-munity Flock 1 I Run Pigeon Run
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there Flock! 🐦👋[/h3]
Tom here, Community Manager for Headbangers: Rhythm Royale. Today is the beginning of a new segment, so...
[h2]Welcome to our Coo-munity Flock![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/33db597f776f69c91bd38974b15051e9c7f26cb7.jpg[/img]
In our Coo-munity Flock segments, we will be breaking down specific gameplay elements of Headbangers and soaring into never seen before features! So, are you ready for some never seen before gameplay footage? For today's Coo-munity Flock, we take a look at our first round minigame, Run Pigeon Run!

[h2]Run Pigeon Run[/h2]
A test of timing, Run Pigeon Run challenges players to hit approaching objects in rhythm. Want to progress to the next round? Well you need im-peck-able timing! This minigame has very simple controls, however the speed that objects will appear can cause a bit of chaos.

Run Pigeon Run is a first-round minigame, so you’ll be competing against 29 other pigeon-players. In round one of Headbangers, 20 players move on to round two and the bottom ten pigeons are eliminated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/772d5f4f41467221bcb228c99b554328c5ba5a92.gif[/img]

As the music begins, icons will appear either at the top or bottom of the screen. As the icon appears over the button, hit it! However use the music to guide your timing! Hit the corresponding button when the icon appears over the button and use the music to guide your timing.

Progress for Run Pigeon Run is rated by a scoring system, with 100 points gained for hitting a target in time. If you are perfectly in time with the music, you will gain 150 points for each perfect hit. You can see when you’ve gained a perfect hit, as the star icon will appear after the object hit. Miss an object entirely and you will lose 20 points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/9216fb572a1a56f9673de8106a3e54637e670470.gif[/img]

Want to see more of a specific element of headbangers? Bready... I mean ready to hit us with a Headbangers question? Leave a comment below and we will answer it! Or maybe your question will be covered in our next Coo-munity Flock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/a1f33d5377e7322289950f72e845e60993b1aa3d.gif[/img]

Alongside this information around Run Pigeon Run, we are happy to to announce that Headbangers: Rhythm Royale will contain an all-free Battle Pass with tons of customisation items, allowing you to perfect your Pigeon style and be the coo-lest Pigeon in the Flock. We will have more information about this next week.

That's all for Coo-munity Flock 1, we hope you have enjoyed today's segment. And remember, stay keep pecking away at life and get that bread! 🍞

notes.title: Headbangers: Rhythm Royale launches 31st October 2023!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there Flock! 👋[/h3]
Today we revealed a first look at gameplay for rhythm-based battle royale game Headbangers: Rhythm Royale! Not only that, we also revealed that Headbangers: Rhythm Royale launches on 31st October 2023 for Steam! 

[previewyoutube=R_l_SQBmIEA;full][/previewyoutube]
We cannot wait for you to get your beaks into Headbangers: Rhythm Royale and enjoy musical minigame chaos! Today we have some new im-peck-able information around Headbangers for you to soar into! 

Headbangers places players into the perfectly preened plumage of a pigeon, finally answering the age-old question, ‘What is going on in their head?’ Naturally, the answer is music through a series of increasingly tense rounds of chaotic musical minigames, which test a player’s memory, rhythm, reflexes, reaction time, and (obviously) their ability to rap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/afc974998bd2f489b575d4adc58750d1dae01175.gif[/img]

[h2]Headbangers Key Features:[/h2]
[h3]23 Musical Minigames[/h3]
Memory, rhythm, knowledge, reflexes, and reaction times will be put to the test across 23 minigames, each with their own unique musical twist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/820dcf54aac1c7bcd3cbbad8f75903e6f00f1043.gif[/img]

Players will showcase their im-peck-able memory skills by copying the commanders’ instructions in Yes Commander; play the piano with a slingshot (yes really) in First Piano Shooter; be the first off the mark and into the solar system in To The Sky; and much, much more across 23 musically inspired minigames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/a85882127045606200e80b41bfb66fb6b8fe23b4.gif[/img]

[h3]Pigeon Customisation[/h3]
With hundreds of unique items to choose from, including full outfits, hats, glasses, voices, and taunts, players can take the top spot and fluff their feathers with their very own personalised pigeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/fc86aac052ec9efa4ed81656264dd0f7b9205faa.gif[/img]

[h3]Earn Breadcrumbs[/h3]
Challenges and unlockable customisations await, with players able to spend their hard-earned crumbs to help them be the most stylish pigeon in the flock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/6454ac1da548d40a2de2dc0beb83cd8fae767bc3.gif[/img]

[h3]30 Pigeon Player Lobbies[/h3]
Soar into mayhem and compete against up to 29 other avians! Remember, only one pigeon can become the Master Headbanger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/5f34fb8e19cf3f2f472e509b082d87addcb6da36.gif[/img]

[h3]All-Free Battle Pass[/h3]
View XP progress in the all-free battle pass to unlock new customisation items for your pigeon. Battle pass items vary from full costumes, costume items, sounds, taunts, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/7a6e8700cbfcafd4c9989edb208b4c24f31e3cc3.gif[/img]

[h3]Crossplay for all![/h3]
Play with up to 30 pigeons on any platform. No matter your friend’s device of choice to play on, you can flock together, battling it out to see who is crowned the Master Headbanger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232874/b95e2574d85f2dbc860c72a432605722c608ce9f.gif[/img]

[h3]That’s all… for now, Flock! 👋[/h3]
